emails.subject: Baxter Freight quoting capacity
emails.html:
Dear Peter,

Baxter Freight runs its own innovation team, and the quote desk is a practical place to test new tools: how quickly a new rate request becomes a consistent, checked quote.

We are Tiph, a software company in London, and we built Kazinga for the quoting side of a forwarder's day. It uses AI to read incoming rate requests, then prices them from your own tariffs and margin, and drafts the reply. Your team checks every quote and sends it. Your data is stored in the EU and encrypted, and Tiph cannot read it.

Would a 20-minute demo be useful?

Kind regards,
